name: Agency Showroom Slot Contract v1
purpose: Define exactly where external visuals are allowed to enter Joey's P0 agency showroom before any paid generation is considered.
globalRules: Every slot must work on mobile and desktop; no desktop-only wow proof.
First frame/static state must already communicate premium quality; motion is optional enhancement.
Do not generate public proof, reviews, customer results or certifications.
Do not expose internal prompts, model recipes or asset registries on a public agency build.
Prefer coded UI/screenshots for interface proof and interaction sections; use generated media only where it adds visual value that code cannot provide cheaply.
One visual system beats many unrelated hero concepts. Once art direction is approved, every external visual must share material, light, contrast and red-accent logic.
Keep all source masters crop-safe so customer/showcase derivatives do not require a full regeneration.
No paid generation from this contract until the visual-content hypothesis for that slot is explicitly approved or becomes an implementation necessity.

artDirectionHypotheses.name: White Precision
artDirectionHypotheses.risk: can become sterile or generic SaaS if there is no distinctive object/material story

artDirectionHypotheses.name: Warm Luxury
artDirectionHypotheses.risk: can drift into generic interior/luxury branding and lose technical sharpness

artDirectionHypotheses.name: Hybrid Precision Luxury
artDirectionHypotheses.palette: white canvas + deep red brand accent + warm stone/chrome imagery
artDirectionHypotheses.risk: requires strict restraint so materials do not become decorative noise

slots.role: signature visual object that makes the agency feel expensive before the user reads supporting copy
allowedContentHypotheses: one premium material/technical sculptural object with controlled red accent
one abstract transformation object that visually changes as the first scroll begins
one close architectural/material composition that can become a motion master
rejectContent: generic laptop mockup as the hero
AI collage of many website screens
embedded text/logos generated inside the image

desktop.targetBox: right-column visual, approx 4:5/1:1 crop inside hero
desktop.safeZone: central 70% must contain the recognizable subject

stillGate: distinctive enough to remember after leaving the page
desktop and mobile crops feel intentionally composed
can support subtle motion without requiring motion to make sense
slots.motionGate: Only animate after the still direction is approved; keep first frame saleable and avoid destabilizing surrounding copy/layout.
slots.suggestedModelClass: cinematic premium still model after art direction approval; use precise image editing for crop/repair rather than regenerating identity

slots.role: prove interaction craft immediately after the first viewport
slots.currentState: coded scroll response on hero placeholder

desktop.behavior: hero visual changes position/lighting/state over first 0-1 viewport of scroll

mobile.behavior: same narrative payoff with reduced travel; no horizontal choreography

slots.gate: User notices a deliberate premium response without losing scroll control or causing jank.
slots.paidSpendRule: No separate generation if CSS/JS transformation of AG-HERO-001 is enough.

slots.role: show Premium Plumbing as the first reusable customer system in a credible desktop + mobile presentation
slots.externalMediaNeed: no agency-specific AI media; source should be the actual Plumbing demo and later its approved visuals

desktop.capture: real browser/screenshot of the current Plumbing demo after its showcase state is approved

slots.gate: Both devices clearly belong to one site/system; demo status remains explicit until real client proof exists.
slots.paidSpendRule: Plumbing image generation belongs to the Plumbing asset plan, not a duplicate agency-showroom generation.

slots.role: make the value proposition visually understandable in under five seconds
slots.contentDecision: interaction pattern to be tested before visual generation

desktop.preferred: scrub/slider or scroll-bound comparison with real coded mock states

mobile.preferred: vertical/tap/scrub comparison; never a tiny desktop slider squeezed onto 390px

slots.gate: Difference in perceived quality is immediate; no fabricated client success claim; keyboard/touch usable.
slots.paidSpendRule: Do not generate before/after imagery unless coded states fail to communicate the transformation.

slots.role: demonstrate one interaction technology that could later be sold as a premium add-on
slots.contentDecision: open; interaction utility must be defined before art
slots.gate: Interaction improves comprehension, trust or perceived quality and can be reused on a customer site; otherwise reject as decoration.
slots.paidSpendRule: Code first. Add generated asset only after the reusable interaction itself passes.

slots.role: make the service simple enough to understand and buy
slots.gate: Final public price language matches the actually deliverable scope; no visual generation required.

desktop.acceptedSources: real client website capture, real project result, real quoted feedback with permission

mobile.acceptedSources: same real evidence in mobile-safe card/crop

slots.gate: Every claim/source can be traced to a real customer or measurable fact.

slots.role: close the story with one low-friction next action
slots.externalMediaNeed: none unless future hero art can be reused cheaply
slots.contentDecision: contact mechanism and final brand/copy open
slots.gate: One obvious action; thumb-friendly mobile CTA; no decorative asset required to understand the next step.

generationPriorityAfterApproval: 1. AG-HERO-001 only — build/select the visual DNA master.
2. Test AG-HERO-001 desktop + mobile crop in the real coded page.
3. Decide whether AG-FIRSTSCROLL-001 can reuse the same master without a second generation.
4. Use real Plumbing page captures for AG-SHOWCASE-PL-001; do not duplicate generation spend.
5. Keep AG-TRANSFORM-001 and AG-INTERACT-001 code-first until they prove they need external media.
6. Never spend on AG-OFFER-001, AG-PROOF-001 or AG-CTA-001 merely to make them decorative.

estimatedAgencyPaidVisualCount.likely: 1-3 selected master/derivative visuals before any optional motion
estimatedAgencyPaidVisualCount.reason: The agency showroom should demonstrate design and interaction primarily through the actual coded site and real showcase screens, not by becoming an AI-image gallery.
